headline: El Al Buys Back 20% Frequent Flyer Stake at $1.15 Billion Valuation
summary: Israeli airline El Al repurchased the 20% stake in its frequent flyer loyalty program from insurer The Phoenix at an implied business valuation of NIS 4.2 billion.
why: Airline loyalty programs are high-margin assets that frequently provide balance sheet liquidity during structural debt restructurings.

impacts.name: El Al
impacts.why: Reacquiring full ownership of its loyalty program consolidates customer revenue streams.
